description: Agent Governance: submit a seller’s agent-discovery setup: the offer with its price, terms and last change, and every surface where buying agents find it (registries, directories, agent cards, feeds, marketplaces and MCP servers), each with whether it lists the offer, the price and terms it shows, when it last took the offer, how changes reach it and which agents find the seller only there. The signed report names every surface where the offer is missing, stale or contradicts the offer or another surface on price or terms, and every single surface whose failure makes the seller invisible to buying agents. One listing’s quality is wever_listing-check and how a router chooses a seller is wever_router-disclosure-check. Verdict contradictory, coverage_gaps, coverage_unverified or consistent. POST /api/discovery-coverage-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-governance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-governance/.
